summary_1line: Victor recounts his idyllic childhood, friendships with Elizabeth and Clerval, and the beginnings of his obsession with forbidden natural philosophy.

image_candidates.scene_text: A bolt of lightning strikes a tall oak near the house, leaving it blasted into thin ribbons of wood as Victor watches the storm.
Young Victor excitedly shows his father a dusty volume of Cornelius Agrippa in an inn during a stormy journey.
Elizabeth stands peacefully among the Alpine scenery of Switzerland, gazing at mountains while Victor studies nature’s mysteries.
